notes.title: PMC Promiscuity - Animation Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Build 1.2 - Animation Overhaul[/h1][p][/p][p]We're delighted to put out a complete overhaul of PMC Promiscuity that brings your beloved mercenaries to life with fully animated character sprites complete with voice-matching animated mouths, dozens of expressive faces, and a ton of newly animated artwork for almost* all the game's ero scenes! [/p][p][/p][p]Not only have we fully revamped our character art, but we've also added in a completely new (and much requested) game mode: True Visual Novel Mode! Don't want pesky mini-games and relationship progression getting in the way of chatting shit with your fav merc? Now you can simply select the new game mode when starting a fresh save and there will be nothing to interrupt your socializing![/p][p][/p][p]There's been a whole host of other changes too: new artwork, improved performance, better options for lower end machines to disable potentially processor intensive effects, dozens of bug fixes big and small, writing improvements and a ton of quality of life improvements![/p][p][/p][p]As always you'll be able to find the full change-log in game![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your patience and support while we have undertaken this absurdly big update, we can't wait to hear how you like the newly refined game!

More content is already recorded, written, and in some cases drawn & animated, so stay tuned for content updates in the near future! As well as new content, group ero scenes are still being animated and will be patched into the game in the near future! (All assuming nothing goes wrong in the interim!)

Enjoy!

 - The Overseer Division Team[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Build 1.2 - Animated, improved, and overhauled!
notes.notes:
Hello to all our returning veterans and the many new recruits who joined the illustrious Manticore International team over the holidays during our sale!

For many of you this will be the first big update you'll have seen from our dev team, so just in case you're unfamiliar: hey there, I'm Amber, I'm the writer/coder for PMC Promiscuity and on behalf of the Overseer Division team I am delighted to share with you the enormous changes the shortly upcoming update will be bringing to the game!

[h1]Changes coming in build 1.2:[/h1]

[h2](Much requested) Core game changes![/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to start the game in 'true visual novel' mode, removing the need to play any mini-games and simply enjoy the story and sex scenes at your own pace!
[*] Added the ability to opt out of transition animations when moving between areas, instead playing a simplified and much quicker version!
[/list]

[h2]Animations![/h2]
[list]
[*] Climax artwork for all of Adelaide and Shizu's solo sex scenes are now animated
[*] All character sprites are now animated
[*] All character expressions are individually animated
[*] Character's mouths will now animate to match the voice line being spoken
[*] All animations are individually toggleable in game settings at any time to accommodate lower end PCs
[/list]

[h2]New Artwork![/h2]
[list]
[*] New brat taming artwork for mangy fox
[*] Multiple new (and animated!) artwork pieces for Adelaide's 'leadership RP exercise'
[*] Multiple new (and animated!) artwork pieces for Adelaide's strip search
[*] New title screen artwork!
[/list]

[h2]Alongside [u]many[/u] miscellaneous fixes, changes, and other additions still being worked on![/h2]

Overall our aim for this update is to get the ground-works for both animation and being able to play the game as a more traditional novel all sorted first and foremost, then to begin adding all new content safe in the knowledge everything is working as intended and the new content won't disrupt existing content!

As you can imagine, as a very small team the holidays and illnesses/other obligations can limit hours spent working on the game, so I'd personally like to thank everyone for your patience as we continue to get this frighteningly big overhaul finished up for you all to enjoy!

As for an ETA for build 1.2, we're aiming for 2-3 weeks from time of posting, being conservative to give us plenty of time to accommodate any unexpected issues! If you would like to get a sneak peak at character animations, feel free to check out @AmberFiend on Blueksy, I fairly frequently post snippets and behind the scenes for the game there!

Any questions please do let me know in the comments, or if you kinda just feel like yelling nonsense at a dev that's dope too it's pretty fun, and I'll reply to you either way! 

- Amber (On behalf of all of us at Overseer Division)

[h1]PMC Promiscuity 2024 Roadmap[/h1]

Hi all! So first and foremost, we've all been working hard tackling the areas of the game we've received feedback and improvement suggestions about! They're listed above, and as many are already practically ready to roll out and just require further testing, you can expect them to be rolled out over the next week!

Over the next 6 months we're going to be [b]over doubling the number of dialogue scenes[/b]: adding all the world building, drama, degenerate behavior and dirty little secrets you could ever hope to listen to!

Any questions you might have, pop them under this post and I'll (Amber, hello!)  get back to you with either help or a witty response depending on the sincerity of your question! [/b]

notes.title: Build 1.1 - Minigames, New Shizu H-scene, new GUI. and many improvements!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

First of all I'd love to thank everyone for their support, patience, and constructive criticism guiding us towards which areas to improve/change/remove!

Our launch was a lot sooner than we'd have otherwise liked due to a change in personal situation beyond our control, as well as not wishing to miss out on the promotional opportunity of the Hexpo live stream (Shoutout to them!), and as such was certainly less polished than we'd have otherwise liked the launch build to be.

However, with your help, we've been able to swiftly identify bugs, areas of improvement, and what you loved so we know to add more of; all of which we have been adding to/fixing in the game as quickly as possible!

[h2]So firstly, major changes this update:[/h2]

   + Added new voiced Shizu sex scene featuring the wonderful @CinderDryadVA! As an early thank you for your patience with us patching post-launch! <3

	+ Bug fixed and refined new ending scene(for content so far)!

	+ Added new lockpicking minigame! (SFX coming within 24 hours!)

	+ Added new Armory minigame! (SFX coming within 24 hours!)

	+ Transitions only occur with new dialogues/sex scenes, not minigames!

	+ Added back, history, and auto forwarding buttons (Previous implementation of character animation/characters per second messed with this functionality and has since been removed)

	+ Added new voiced Shizu dialogue

	+ Added dialogue improvements throughout

	+ New animated profile pictures available in the points shop!

	+ Added beginning and ending screens to Minigames (Will update when overhauling minigames to progress towards sex scenes not all dialogues)

	+ Assets added for shooting range minigame ready to implement

	+ Added custom GUI assets for decisions

	+ Correction to credits to include our wonderfully talented pixel artist

[h2]Secondly, here's what you've got to look forward to (as soon as within the next 24 hours!)[/h2]

+ A detailed roadmap of all the [b]FREE [/b]content we'll be updating the game with throughout it's lifecycle, so you know what you've got to look forward to in the very near future!

+ The fourth and final minigame to be added!

+ Complete SFX overhaul, to bring the minigames, dialogue scenes, and menus to life!

Once again, the support we've received has been tremendous and the patience you've had for us as a tiny development team has been both immensely appreciated and tremendous motivation to make this as polished and as enjoyable an experience as possible.

- Amber
